verdict.rationale: Escalating a live call to a human is a fair telephony question for a voice agent API. The pack documents function calling, agent-to-agent handoff in a multi-agent setup, and a Twilio audio bridge. None of it documents warm or blind transfer to a human with context passed along. Function calling is a developer building block, and multi-agent handoff is adjacent agent-to-agent routing, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can escalate a live call to a human with warm or blind transfer, passing context along
